name: Night-closed folded blossoms 002
glow_concept: soul-light shining up through gaps between pads
prompt: a floating clump of overlapping round water lily pads with a few cupped blossoms and short trailing stems, drawn alone with no water beneath, night-closed folded blossoms, tiny, ankle-height to an adult person, self-emissive at night, softly radiating light: soul-light shining up through gaps between pads

placement.note: Render the sprite scaled so its height == world_px_height; a character is character_height_px tall.

motion.description: This is an almost completely still picture. ONLY the outermost edge of the two white flowers on the pads changes, and barely: a few pixels along that edge lift very slightly in brightness and drop straight back. The two white flowers on the pads is fully visible and exactly as easy to read in every frame -- it never fades, never vanishes and is never swallowed by glare. Its inside stays exactly the white it is in the first frame. Nothing is added or removed anywhere, and nothing changes size. Everything else is copied from the first frame exactly, pixel for pixel: same shape, size, position and colour. The last frame matches the first exactly.
